source: Answers that cannot be provoked on demand from a public testnet server: a rate limit, an internal failure (fullnode error or staleness), a permissioned server refusing a package. Seal bodies are built from crates/key-server/src/errors.rs at MystenLabs/seal 024b523e (InternalError::as_str, From<InternalError> for ErrorResponse, IntoResponse statuses). The 429 bodies follow the gateway in front of Mysten's servers, whose recorded 401 ('No API key found in request', request_id) is Kong's key-auth wording; 'API rate limit exceeded' is the matching rate-limiting wording. A 429 counts as RateLimited whatever its body (H11), so one 429 has an empty body and one a Seal-shaped body.

failure.body: {"error":"Failure","message":"Internal server error, please try again later"}
